newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends mixed, influenced by NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends mixed, influenced by NY.

text.p: LIFFE coffee ended mixed with the most active contracts close to unchanged.
London followed New York, with little direction of its own, trader said
Active May last traded two dollars down at $1,655, having moved from a low of $1,645 to a high of $1,683 and then come back down again.
"When it goes up it runs into origin selling and when it comes down you get industry price fixing. I guess it's rangebound," one trader said.
May volume was 2,736 of a total 4,696 lots.
Delegates to an Association of Coffee Producing Countriess (ACPC) technical group meeting in London said that there was no proposal to suspend the current export quota programme for arabica coffees.
President of Costa Rica's Ecafe exporter group Ricardo Seevers said that "There is no such proposal,"
There were earlier reports that Colombia would raise the question of quota suspension at the meeting in view of the recent high prices.
